The truth was that a technician at the lab was repeatedly interjecting inputs to make the chatbot sound more intelligent, but nobody at the time realized this. It wasn’t until years later that a second technician confirmed the deceit, leading to the story being classified as an early example of “cultural drift” in AI.

This story demonstrates the need for caution and transparency in the development and presentation of AI systems.
